action.new_text:
# Validate inputs
    for name, mat in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(mat, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if mat.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if mat.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(mat)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if not np.all(mat <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean value")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    # Sum over horizon
    sum_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    sum_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    sum_no = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
    best_no = np.maximum(sum_call, sum_no)
    diff = sum_with - best_no
    loss = np.maximum(0, -diff)
    keep = loss < tau_filter
    margins = loss
    return keep, margins
